name: Clyb 4M SDE momentumized
plain: A DPM++ 3M SDE style multistep extended to one more history term, with a velocity blend applied to both the ODE part and the SDE correction term. It builds on a Perlin default noise sampler in this variant. Momentum smooths step-to-step update direction.
math:
t=−logσᵢ, s=−logσᵢ₊₁, h=s−t, h_η=h(η+1).
x ← e^{−h_η}x + v₁ where v₁ blends (1−e^{−h_η})·x0.
With 3 past x0: r0=h₃/h₂, r1=h₂/h, r2=h/h₁; divided differences d1, d2; φ₃=(e^{−h_η}−1)/h_η+1, φ₄=φ₃/h_η−½; x += v₂ of (φ₃d1 − φ₄d2). Lower history falls back to 3M and 2M terms.
Noise: x += n·σᵢ₊₁·√(1−e^{−2hη})·s_noise.
v = m·(t + off)·v_prev + (1 − m·(t + off))·diff with t = σᵢ/σ_max, off = −m/2, m = momentum.

props.order: up to 4 history terms; order not proven
